premium.title: Kalako Premium
premium.tagline: Play like a VIP. Your lies deserve a bigger stage.
premium.feature1: Every future expansion pack, included — picture rounds, new categories, and more, without spending a single coin.
premium.feature2: 500 bonus coins dropped into your account every month you're subscribed. Fuel for your best bluffs.
premium.feature3: 3 exclusive cosmetic items you literally cannot get any other way — hat, eyes, and a frame that scream Premium.
premium.feature4: Host rooms of up to 30 players instead of 20. More people to fool, more chaos to enjoy.
premium.feature5: A shiny Premium badge follows you into every lobby, every result screen, every leaderboard. Let them know who they're dealing with.
premium.upsellNudge: That one's a Premium perk — worth a look?
